options.title: La P'tite Verte

options.why: A lower-priced, convivial fondue night that suits a group.

options.title: Le Monchu

options.why: Traditional fondue with a lively, cozy atmosphere for the whole group.

options.title: Le Fer à Cheval

options.title: Aiguille du Midi cable car
options.description: A two-stage cable car ride from central Chamonix up to a high alpine viewpoint facing Mont Blanc.
options.why: Gives the non-skiers a big mountain outing with panoramic views, without needing any skiing.
options.location: 100 pl de l'aiguille du Midi, 74400 Chamonix-Mont-Blanc

options.title: Montenvers train to Mer de Glace
options.description: A rack railway up to the Mer de Glace glacier, with a gondola and an ice cave to visit.
options.why: A relaxed half-day trip that suits non-skiers, with the ice cave as a highlight in winter.

options.title: QC Terme Chamonix spa
options.description: A spa in Chamonix offering a warm, restful afternoon after time outdoors in the cold.
options.why: A low-key option for a slower day, fitting for those who want to rest rather than be active.

options.title: El Xampanyet
options.description: Old-school El Born tapas bar known for cava and anchovies, in a tiled space dating to 1929.
options.why: A classic, lively first night in Barcelona, mid-range and walk-in friendly.

options.title: Bar Cañete
options.description: Upmarket classic tapas bar in El Raval with a marble counter and polished, traditional plates.
options.why: A special-feeling first dinner, with a sit-down option for the group.

options.title: Quimet & Quimet
options.description: Tiny standing-room bodega in Poble Sec known for built-to-order montaditos and tinned seafood.
options.why: A fun, casual stop with a different style from the other two picks.

options.title: Picasso Museum
options.description: Art museum in the Gothic Quarter with an extensive collection of Picasso's works from his early years.
options.why: Indoor art stop that suits a rainy day in Barcelona.

options.title: Fundació Joan Miró
options.description: Modern art museum on Montjuïc hill with the largest collection of Joan Miró's art, plus a rooftop terrace view.
options.why: Fully indoor galleries, and it's a good pick if the rain clears for the terrace view.

options.title: CosmoCaixa Museum Of Science
options.description: Hands-on science museum with an immersive indoor rainforest.
options.why: Interactive and indoor, good for a rainy afternoon.

options.title: Café Bluebird
options.description: A casual café that locals and expats use for a filling morning meal before heading out on the slopes or trails.
options.why: A hearty, low-key start before a ski day.
options.location: 155 Place Edmond Desailloud, Chamonix Sud, opposite the Aiguille du Midi

options.title: Le Fournil Chamoniard
options.description: A bakery where reviewers praise the bread and say it works well for a breakfast stop.
options.why: An affordable, quick morning option with fresh bread.

options.title: Omeletterie La Poële
options.description: An omelette-focused spot that reviewers describe as a good breakfast, brunch or lunch choice.
options.why: Good for a sit-down breakfast with egg dishes.

options.title: Galerie Cafe des Aiguilles
options.description: A café that reviewers rate highly for its breakfast.
options.why: Well-reviewed breakfast in the town centre.

options.title: Arcus Coffee, Chamonix
options.description: A coffee spot on Avenue Cachat Le Géant that reviewers say is a good place for breakfast and pastries.
options.why: A relaxed coffee-and-breakfast stop in the centre.

options.title: Casa Valerio
options.description: Town-centre spot known for pizza and fresh pasta.
options.why: A lower-cost sit-down dinner than the places already shown.

options.title: La Roulotte
options.description: Italian pizza place with affordable prices.
options.why: A budget-friendly pizza dinner that fits the cheaper ask.

options.title: Poco Loco
options.description: Casual burger and cafe spot in Argentière.
options.why: One of the lowest-priced dinner options around Chamonix.

options.title: Casa Valerio
options.description: Authentic Italian restaurant in Chamonix with a cosy dinner setting by the river.
options.why: A sit-down Italian dinner that suits a group, and it's away from fondue.

options.title: Le Comptoir des Alpes
options.description: Restaurant in Chamonix town centre serving Italian specialities with a Franco-Italian menu, including a sunny terrace.
options.why: Italian-leaning menu in the centre, with a dinner service that starts at 7pm.
options.location: 151 Avenue de l'Aiguille du Midi, 74400 Chamonix-Mont-Blanc

options.title: Pizzeria des Moulins
options.description: Italian pasta restaurant in central Chamonix, highly rated by reviewers.
options.why: A relaxed, central Italian option for a group dinner, and cheaper than the fine-dining picks.

options.title: Caelis
options.description: One-star Michelin restaurant in the Ohla Barcelona hotel, with a lunch menu alongside its tasting menus.
options.why: A special, celebratory lunch that is a clear step up in price from the options shown.

options.title: Lasarte
options.description: Three-star restaurant in the Monument Hotel with a seasonal lunch menu.
options.why: The most special option here, for a splurge lunch that's a fraction of its dinner price.

options.title: Estimar
options.description: Seafood room in El Born with two Repsol Suns and a Michelin Guide listing.
options.why: A destination seafood lunch that is a splurge pick, without the tasting-menu format.

options.why: A cosy spot with a relaxed après-ski feel, away from the busiest bars.
